name: LensGuard
author: Shirak Semonian
description: Camera activity guard for the Omarchy bar: quietly watches which process holds /dev/video* open and clearly shows when the webcam is in use. Whitelisted apps (zoom, obs, teams, chrome, ...) get a calm yellow status; an unknown process triggers a red alert with one notification naming the command and PID. Detects any app that opens the camera — including browsers, because PipeWire opens the device on their behalf. Panel shows live details, event history and whitelist management. No service, no key, no network.

barWidget.description: Camera activity guard — shows when a process uses the webcam
